a.name: Serif Italic
a.language: One serif in roman and italic on warm off-white, italic numerals for dates, tabular figures for data, one soft colour wash rising from the bottom edge as the only colour

features.data: 'tnum' 1 (default in this family, verified: digit advance equal in every cut)
features.oldstyle: 'onum' 1 on the italic date line only

a.idea: A serif in roman and italic on warm off-white, italic date numerals, one colour wash rising from the bottom edge.

b.name: Swiss Numerals
b.language: A flush-left grid where the date is the biggest thing: day numerals in a light neo-grotesk set in the one dark column, two-tone title, rows on hairlines, one accent used only for the highlight and the total

features.data: default digits are tabular in every Hanken Grotesk cut (digit advance 560 of 1000, verified), so no feature is needed

b.idea: A flush-left grid where the date is the biggest thing, set in the one dark column, with one red accent.

c.name: Quiet Tint
c.language: One sans in two weights and three type steps on a tinted ground; tone and weight make the hierarchy, and the one accent is a solid pill under the special row, the highlighted names and the total

features.data: 'tnum' 1 on every number (Figtree has the feature, default digits are proportional; digit advances 626 and 632 once baked)

c.idea: One sans in two weights on a tinted ground; the only accent is a solid pill under whatever is special.

d.name: Civic Board
d.language: A departure-board look: a black header band carries the title in mono caps, figures are mono (tabular by nature), words are a condensed grotesque, rows sit on hairlines and the highlight is an inverted row

features.data: Plex Mono digits are 600/1000 em wide in every cut and Plex Sans Condensed digits 540/1000, so amounts and times align with no feature (verified)

d.idea: A departure board: black header band, mono figures, condensed words, and an inverted row for the highlight.

data.note: Every name, number and account is made up. The verse is sample text built to test 60 words, not a Bible quotation. Mock strings carry no middot and no dash (docs/design-questions.md section 8); the range word 'sampai' stands where Words::range writes an en dash.

verses: Beginilah firman TUHAN yang menciptakan engkau, hai Yakub: Janganlah takut, sebab Aku telah menebus engkau, Aku telah memanggil engkau dengan namamu, engkau ini kepunyaan-Ku.
Apabila engkau menyeberang melalui air, Aku akan menyertai engkau; apabila engkau berjalan melalui api, engkau tidak akan hangus, dan nyala api tidak akan menghanguskan engkau.
Sebab Aku ini TUHAN, Allahmu, Yang Mahakudus, Allah Israel, dan Juruselamatmu.
